tokens.name: brand-midnight
tokens.usage: Brand primitive. Headers, the header band on reports, main text on light grounds, the app icon tile.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Brand primitive. Raised surfaces in dark mode.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Brand primitive, signal blue. Section headings accents, links, chart bars on light grounds. Too dark for text on midnight (2.2:1): use accent in dark mode.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Brand primitive, the one bright highlight. The mic head, star icons, the single primary call-to-action. Never body text on light grounds.

tokens.name: brand-gold-deep
tokens.usage: Brand primitive. Gold for text and small icons on paper or white (5.1:1 on paper).

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: Brand primitive. Page background in place of pure white; text on midnight.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Light: paper, never pure white. Dark: midnight.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels sitting on bg.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Tiles nested inside a card, such as summary stat tiles.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Anything that floats above the page: the bottom bar. One step lighter than surface in dark mode so the bar stands apart without a shadow.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg, surface and surface-sunken (16.5:1 light, 14.5:1 dark on surface).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, captions, helper text, on bg, surface and surface-sunken (5.1:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards, tiles and dividers. Decorative only, never the sole marker of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Outlines that carry meaning: empty checkboxes, to-do hexagons, input borders. At least 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, chart bars, focus rings and small emphasis on bg and surface (7.6:1 light, 6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Soft blue fill: confirmed status pills, avatar initials, shortcut squares, the active nav pill's family. Text on it uses accent or ink.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Gold fill for the one main action: the Add hexagon in apps, the primary button on client pages. Also filled rating stars and a reached milestone. Text on it uses on-highlight.

tokens.name: highlight-text
tokens.usage: Gold-colored text or small icons on bg and surface.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text and icons on highlight (10.2:1).

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Full-width header band on client pages, the navy fade under text on photos, and every backdrop behind sheets and menus (at 60%). Text on it uses brand-paper.

tokens.name: on-band-muted
tokens.usage: Labels and metadata on band and on photos under the navy fade (11:1 on midnight). Main text there is brand-paper.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, overdue, failed, unread count. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background for danger text and icons (badges, inline messages). Every pairing passes AA in both themes.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention soon. A burnt orange, never amber or gold.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background for warning text and icons (badges, inline messages). Every pairing passes AA in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, paid, sent, saved.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background for success text and icons (badges, inline messages). Every pairing passes AA in both themes.

families.display: "DM Serif Display", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Title slides and hero headlines. The wordmark's face.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page and report headlines on desktop.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Page and report headlines on mobile.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles and list item titles.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers in stat tiles. Use tabular figures.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Attendees said the session made AI feel doable.
styles.usage: Running text on desktop. 16px on mobile.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Attendees described learning how to set up an AI assistant.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Stat labels, form labels, button text at small size. Sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata and footnotes. Nothing in the system goes below 14px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a tile, between label and number.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between tiles and between stacked list items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on mobile; minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a section heading; between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Header band padding and space between major sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of hero areas and title slides.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls inside menus and inline messages.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, buttons, tiles, the profile menu.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Photo cards, Quick add tiles, shortcut squares, modals, the search panel.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The floating bottom bar and the top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and progress bar tracks.
